result.instructions: Tools for Sociamonials, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which posts are scheduled for our client workspaces this week?"; "Draft a post for the spring sale and schedule it for Tuesday at 9:00 UTC."; "How did last month's posts perform on LinkedIn and Instagram?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sociamonials data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sociamonials_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sociamonials_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sociamonials_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sociamonials_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sociamonials_whoami
tools.title: Show my key's permissions
tools.description: Show what this API key may do: the agent, the credential, the plan entitlement and the permission map for each workspace. Call it first. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: sociamonials_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the client or brand workspaces this key can reach, with each workspace's permissions and whether posts need approval. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/workspaces.

tags.description: Comma-separated workspace tags to filter by.

tag_match.description: Match any tag or all tags (default any).

tools.name: sociamonials_list_social_profiles
tools.title: List social profiles
tools.description: List the social profiles of one workspace: network, profile_ref (needed to publish), connection state and whether this key can publish to it. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/social-profiles.

tools.name: sociamonials_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List the posts of one workspace, filtered by status, network and date window, with paging. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/posts.

status.description: Post status filter, e.g. draft, scheduled, published, pending_approval.

from_utc.description: Start of the window, ISO-8601 UTC.

to_utc.description: End of the window, ISO-8601 UTC.

tools.name: sociamonials_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one post: its message, schedule, queue state, media, approval and delivery flags. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/posts/{id}.

tools.name: sociamonials_get_post_analytics
tools.title: Get post analytics
tools.description: Get the delivery attempts and the engagement metrics (clicks, likes, comments, leads, revenue) of one post. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/posts/{id}/analytics.

tools.name: sociamonials_get_workspace_analytics
tools.title: Get workspace analytics
tools.description: Get the totals (created, delivered, pending, drafts, canceled) and the per-network counts of one workspace for a date window. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/analytics.

from_utc.description: Start of the window, ISO-8601 UTC.

to_utc.description: End of the window, ISO-8601 UTC.

tools.name: sociamonials_list_inbox_conversations
tools.title: List inbox conversations
tools.description: List the Social Inbox conversations of one workspace (comments, messages, mentions, reviews), with cursor paging. Reads the stored inbox and spends no network rate limit. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/inbox/conversations.

sort.description: Sort order as the API defines it.

unread.description: Set to "true" to list only unread conversations.

awaiting_reply.description: Set to "true" to list only conversations awaiting a reply.

tools.name: sociamonials_get_job
tools.title: Get a bulk job
tools.description: Get the status and per-workspace results of a bulk publish job. Sociamonials API: GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Job id returned by a bulk publish.

tools.name: sociamonials_create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: Create a post as a draft, in the posting queue, or scheduled for a time. It never publishes immediately. The account may route it for approval. Sociamonials API: POST /api/v1/posts.

workspace_id.description: Needed only for an agency key; a workspace key infers the workspace.

mode.description: draft saves without scheduling; queue adds the post to the posting queue; scheduled sends at publish_at. Immediate publishing is not offered.

networks.description: Keyed by network code: fb Facebook, tw X, ln LinkedIn, in Instagram, pi Pinterest, gmb Google Business, thrd Threads, tiktok TikTok, yt YouTube, blsk Bluesky. Per-network options go in each entry.

publish_at.description: Required when mode is scheduled. ISO-8601 UTC.

queue_position.description: Queue slot when mode is queue.

link.description: Link to attach to the post.

idempotency_key.description: Optional safe-retry key (max 120 characters). A replay returns the original stored result.

tools.name: sociamonials_schedule_draft
tools.title: Schedule a draft
tools.description: Move a draft to the schedule (at publish_at) or to the posting queue. It never publishes immediately. Sociamonials API: POST /api/v1/posts/{id}/schedule.

mode.description: scheduled sends at publish_at; queue uses the posting queue.

publish_at.description: Required when mode is scheduled. ISO-8601 UTC.

queue_position.description: Queue slot when mode is queue.

tools.name: sociamonials_update_post
tools.title: Edit a post
tools.description: Edit the text, networks, schedule time, media or queue slot of a post. Only the fields you send change. An approved post may return to approval. Sociamonials API: PATCH /api/v1/posts/{id}.

networks.description: Keyed by network code: fb Facebook, tw X, ln LinkedIn, in Instagram, pi Pinterest, gmb Google Business, thrd Threads, tiktok TikTok, yt YouTube, blsk Bluesky. Per-network options go in each entry.

tools.name: sociamonials_cancel_post
tools.title: Cancel a post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled or queued post so it does not send. A post already sent cannot be canceled. This tool never deletes the post permanently. Sociamonials API: DELETE /api/v1/posts/{id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Sociamonials
prompts.description: What you can do with Sociamonials here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_the_posts_scheduled_this_week
prompts.title: Review the posts scheduled this week
prompts.description: List the client workspaces, then list the posts of one workspace filtered by status and date. Open a post to see its schedule and approval state.

prompts.name: check_how_posts_performed
prompts.title: Check how posts performed
prompts.description: Read the clicks, likes, comments and leads of one post. Read the totals and per-network counts of a workspace for a date range.

prompts.name: read_the_social_inbox_of_a_workspace
prompts.title: Read the Social Inbox of a workspace
prompts.description: List the Social Inbox conversations of a workspace, such as comments, messages and mentions. The list reads the stored inbox.

prompts.name: draft_a_post_and_schedule_it
prompts.title: Draft a post and schedule it
prompts.description: Create a post as a draft, in the posting queue or scheduled for a time. Then move a draft to the schedule. Nothing publishes at once.

prompts.name: edit_or_cancel_a_queued_post
prompts.title: Edit or cancel a queued post
prompts.description: Change the text, networks, time or media of a post. Cancel a scheduled or queued post so it does not send; a post already sent cannot be canceled.
